claims.text: Set a minimum threshold
claims.note: The Minimum Threshold tab holds one percentage, labelled "Minimum Threshold (%)" (en-us.json:469), plus the below-threshold options.

claims.text: Keep trivial adjustments from reaching Lynx.
claims.note: The tab header reads "Setting a minimum threshold will prevent very small adjustments from being pushed to Lynx." (en-us.json:471). It works by rewriting below-threshold values in the push, either to 0 or up to the threshold.

claims.text: Stop trivial adjustments reaching Lynx.
claims.note: See minimum-threshold/tile/2.

claims.text: Set the percentage below which a suggestion is either zeroed or lifted to the threshold value.
claims.note: The comparison is strictly "below": each pending station's % Adj. is compared with the threshold (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:437, :443, :449). % Adj. starts as the suggestion, so this is the suggestion unless the user has typed over it.

claims.text: Settings › Minimum Threshold
claims.note: The gear (Settings) button opens the dialog. Minimum Threshold is the second rail entry. The rail labels are hardcoded English literals (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57) and are not translated.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Start state. The Spatial Adjust route is /spatialadjust (app-routing.module.ts:19-23); same wording as dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: Start state. Both dashboard dialogs, Push Changes and Settings, are drawn only while their flag is set, and both flags start false (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:67-68; sa-main-toolbar.component.html:94-112).

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Start state. Same prerequisite as dashboard-overview/before/1: a Spatial Adjust user on a site with TurfRad scan data.

claims.text: The threshold is a site setting, so it applies to every user on the site.
claims.note: Start state. The threshold is stored on the site and applies to every user (minimum-threshold/before/1 and /before/2).

claims.text: The threshold is a site-level setting.
claims.note: The threshold and its option are columns on the site record (Site.cs:40-52), saved through the site settings request (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:486; SitesService.cs:89-90).

claims.text: It applies to every user on the site, not just you.
claims.note: The value is stored once on the site, so every user who opens Settings on that site sees and edits the same value. User preferences are saved through a separate request (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:490).

claims.text: It is applied at push time, not at calculation time — the table keeps showing the raw suggested value.
claims.note: The rules are applied in the browser to the push list only (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:433-460), and the rewritten value is substituted when the push is sent (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:74-82). Suggested and % Adj. in the table keep the unrewritten value.

claims.text: Setting the percentage to 0 disables the feature entirely.
claims.note: A threshold below 1 is saved with the option set to disabled (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:430-432). The option group and Exclude Zeros are greyed out at 0 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:145-170), and a disabled option rewrites nothing (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:454-457).

claims.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 lists the Lynx settings Spatial Adjust depends on: Site Adjust and Course Adjust, Pct. Adjust, and Next Amt.

claims.text: Push changes to Lynx lists the settings under Before you start.
claims.note: Cross-reference within the guides: push-to-lynx/before/4 to /before/9 carry the settings, each from 373-1135 rev 02 §Settings Configuration, p.1.

claims.text: Open Settings
claims.note: The gear button is labelled "Settings".

claims.text: Select the gear button, [[Settings]], at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: The gear button at the right of the toolbar opens Settings (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72; onShowSettings sets the dialog flag, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:276-291). Its text is STRINGS.SETTINGS "Settings" (en-us.json:980).

claims.text: The Settings dialog opens, with a list of tabs down its left side.
claims.note: The dialog is titled with STRINGS.SETTINGS and carries a left column of tab cards, Calculation, Minimum Threshold, Target Profiles and Preferences (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:15-30; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57).

claims.text: If it opens on [[Minimum Threshold]], you used [[Review Threshold]] since the page loaded.
claims.note: The toolbar remembers the tab: Review Threshold sets the Minimum Threshold tab and nothing resets it (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:87, :239-244; sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:99-102). REVIEW_THRESHOLD "Review Threshold" (en-us.json:458). Corrected wording from docs/text-corrections.md §28 is kept.

claims.text: The next step picks the tab you need.
claims.note: The next step selects the tab in the left column (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:21-30, menuItemClick at sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:231-233).

claims.text: The gear button in the toolbar’s right-hand button group.
claims.note: The right-hand group (#sa-tb-right) holds Push Changes, the pushed-today counter and the toolbar buttons, including the gear.

claims.text: Choose the Minimum Threshold tab
In the left rail, select [[Minimum Threshold]], just under [[Calculation]].
claims.note: The rail entries are hardcoded English, Calculation first and Minimum Threshold second (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57), so Minimum Threshold sits just under Calculation.

claims.text: The right side shows the [[Minimum Threshold (%)]] box, with two choices below it for small values.
claims.note: The tab shows the SETTINGS_MIN_THRESHOLD "Minimum Threshold (%)" box with the two Set to ... choices under it (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:135-160; en-us.json:423-424, :469).

claims.text: If you see another tab, select [[Minimum Threshold]] again; Settings opens on [[Calculation]].
claims.note: Settings opens on Calculation unless Review Threshold was used since the page loaded (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:87, :239-244), so the reader may land on another tab; a click on a rail card changes tab (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:231-233).

claims.text: If there is no left rail, select the gear button, [[Settings]], at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: The left rail is part of the Settings dialog, which the gear button opens (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72, :107-112; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:21-30).

claims.text: Settings dialog, Minimum Threshold tab.
claims.note: The tab shows the header text (en-us.json:471) and the field label "Minimum Threshold (%)" (en-us.json:469).

claims.text: Enter the percentage
Type a whole number from 0 to 50 in [[Minimum Threshold (%)]].
claims.note: Same behaviour as the sentence it replaces: whole numbers 0 to 50 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:136-143; decimal-input.component.ts:126-129).

claims.text: The box shows your number.
claims.note: The box is bound to the site setting saMinThresholdPercent (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:136-143).

claims.text: With 0, the threshold is off, and the two choices below stay greyed out.
claims.note: With 0 the option radio group carries the disabled class and both radios are disabled, and the save stores the Disabled option (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:145-162; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:429-433). Same fact as minimum-threshold/before/4.

claims.text: If a digit does not appear, it would take the number above 50, so the dialog refuses it.
claims.note: A keystroke that would take the value above the maximum is refused and the box keeps what it held (decimal-input.component.ts:126-129), with the maximum 50 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:138).

claims.text: Only the dialog enforces that limit.
claims.note: Carried over from the dropped "No server-side check." callout (minimum-threshold/3/5, /3/6): the 0 to 50 bound is enforced by the dialog only.

claims.text: Ten percent is a common start: it drops small changes near target but keeps real fixes.
claims.note: The field accepts 10, and nothing in the product suggests a starting value. Whether 10 percent is a sensible default is an agronomic judgement the source cannot settle. Listed in docs/claims/calculations.md §12. Reworded from "Ten percent is a common starting point: it removes the noise from stations that are already close to target while leaving genuine corrections intact."
claims.question: Is 10 percent a sensible starting Minimum Threshold for most courses, removing noise from stations near target without suppressing genuine corrections?

claims.text: Threshold set to 10 percent.
claims.note: Illustrative value. The field accepts any whole number from 0 to 50.

claims.text: Decide what happens below the line
claims.note: The option group is introduced by "Suggested Percent Adjust values below the minimum threshold will be" (en-us.json:425).

claims.text: Select [[Set to zero when pushed to Lynx]] or [[Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx]].
claims.note: The two radios are MIN_THRESHOLD_OPT_TO_ZERO "Set to zero when pushed to Lynx" and MIN_THRESHOLD_OPT_TO_MIN "Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx" (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:149-162; en-us.json:423-424).

claims.text: Your choice is marked.
claims.note: Each choice is a radio button bound to the selected option (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:149-162).

claims.text: With the second one, [[Exclude Zeros]] below it can be ticked.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros is enabled only while the second option is selected and the threshold is above 0 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:163-170).

claims.text: If both choices are greyed out, the box above holds 0.
claims.note: Both radios are disabled while the threshold is 0 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:145-162), so a number above 0 has to be typed first.

claims.text: Type a number above 0 first.
claims.note: Both radios are disabled while the threshold is 0 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:145-162), so a number above 0 has to be typed first.

claims.text: Zero sends 0% for the station; the second choice raises it to the threshold, so it still gets a small run.
claims.note: Set to zero sets a push value of 0 for a station below the threshold; the second option raises it to the threshold (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:436-447). Reworded from minimum-threshold/4/2 and /4/3.

claims.text: Below-threshold behaviour, with the second option selected.
Keep zeros at zero
claims.note: Step title. The step is about Exclude Zeros (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:163-170).

claims.text: Tick [[Exclude Zeros]] if a station at 0% should stay at 0%.
claims.note: EXCLUDE_ZEROS "Exclude Zeros" is a checkbox (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:163-170; en-us.json:400). With it set, a station already at 0 is left alone (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:448-453).

claims.text: The box is ticked.
claims.note: The checkbox is bound to excludeZeros (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:163-170).

claims.text: At push time, 0% stays 0%, and only small values above 0 are raised.
claims.note: With the second option plus Exclude Zeros, a value below the threshold is raised only if it is not 0 (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:448-453; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:440-442). Applied when pushing, not when saving (minimum-threshold/before/3).

claims.text: If [[Exclude Zeros]] is greyed out, the box above holds 0 or the first choice is selected.
claims.note: The checkbox is disabled unless the second option is selected, or while the threshold is 0 (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:167). A threshold of 0 disables it too (:145-162, :167).

claims.text: Select the second choice first.
claims.note: Both causes of a greyed-out Exclude Zeros have the same way back: a threshold above 0 and the second option selected (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:145-170).

claims.text: Exclude Zeros, available with the second option.
claims.note: Figure caption. Exclude Zeros sits under the second option (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:156-171).

claims.text: Save the threshold
claims.note: Step title. Save Changes is the first button in the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55).

claims.text: Select [[Save Changes]] at the bottom of the dialog.
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.SAVE_CHANGES "Save Changes" is in the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55; en-us.json:459).

claims.text: The dialog closes, and the table keeps showing the same suggestions.
claims.note: On a successful save the dialog emits save and the toolbar closes it (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:107-112; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:186-215). A threshold-only save reloads nothing: it broadcasts the threshold change to the pending list (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:555-557; sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:232-237), and the table keeps the raw suggestion (minimum-threshold/before/3).

claims.text: If a message says Unable to save data, the save failed and the dialog is still open.
claims.note: On a failed save the dialog stays open and the generic save-error message, "Unable to save data", is shown (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-214; dash-message.service.ts:30-33; en-us.json:165-166). The dialog closes only on success (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:107-112).

claims.text: Select [[Save Changes]] again.
claims.note: On a failed save the dialog stays open and the generic save-error message, "Unable to save data", is shown (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-214; dash-message.service.ts:30-33; en-us.json:165-166). The dialog closes only on success (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:107-112).

claims.text: One save keeps the edits on every tab of Settings.
claims.note: Reworded from "One save for every tab." Save Changes saves the edits on every tab of Settings together (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:186-215, :445-468).

claims.text: Save Changes, at the bottom of the Settings dialog.
claims.note: Figure caption. Save Changes is the first button of the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55).

claims.text: Open Push Changes
claims.note: Step title. The Push Changes button is in the right of the toolbar (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:33-42).

claims.text: Select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: The push button sits in the toolbar group on the right (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:33-42) and reads CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_CHANGES "Push Changes", or with a count when something is waiting.

claims.text: A dialog opens with the list of stations waiting to go to Lynx.
claims.note: The button opens the confirm dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:251-253), headed Push Changes and listing the stations waiting and those already pushed today (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:14-30, :64-70).

claims.text: If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, nothing is waiting or a push is still running.
claims.note: The button is disabled when no station is pending or a push is running (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34; isProcessingUpdates is set while a push runs, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:267 and cleared at :324-326).

claims.text: Wait for the push to finish, then look again.
claims.note: The button is disabled when no station is pending or a push is running (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34; isProcessingUpdates is set while a push runs, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:267 and cleared at :324-326).

claims.text: Push Changes, at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Push Changes button is in the right-hand toolbar group (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:33-42).

claims.text: Check the threshold in the push list
claims.note: Step title. The pink banner is drawn in the push dialog when the count is above 0 (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:32-42).

claims.text: Read the pink banner at the top of the list, next to [[Review Threshold]].
claims.note: The banner at the top of the dialog carries a REVIEW_THRESHOLD "Review Threshold" link at its right (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:28-42; en-us.json:458). Its pink colouring is the existing wording of minimum-threshold/5/3.

claims.text: It says how many stations the threshold will adjust, and each of those rows shows its old and new value.
claims.note: The banner gives the number of stations adjusted by the threshold, and an affected row shows the original and the adjusted value (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:32-42, :83-86).

claims.text: If there is no pink banner, no waiting station is below the threshold.
claims.note: The banner is drawn only while the count of stations adjusted by the threshold is above 0 (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:32), so with none there is no banner and no row is changed by the threshold.

claims.text: Nothing is changed by it this time.
claims.note: The banner is drawn only while the count of stations adjusted by the threshold is above 0 (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:32), so with none there is no banner and no row is changed by the threshold.

claims.text: The threshold is applied at push time, so the table still shows the raw suggestion.
claims.note: Carried over from minimum-threshold/before/3: the threshold is applied at push time and the table keeps showing the raw suggested value (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:433-460; sa-table-card.component.ts:417-437).

claims.text: Push dialog.
Two stations were lifted to the threshold; the original and adjusted values are shown together.
claims.note: Illustrative screenshot. The layout matches the template.

claims.text: Push window. Push between 11 AM and the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and synchronise Lynx after the push.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.10 gives the window, 11 AM to the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and says to synchronise after the push. It names no time zone and does not say how to synchronise. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q1 and Q2 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md): is the 11 AM in the course's local time or US Eastern Time, and does the synchronisation Lynx runs at its scheduled time pick up an earlier push, or must the superintendent synchronise Lynx by hand after every push?

claims.text: Outside that window the push does not reach the course, and no error tells you so.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 gives the window but never says what happens outside it, and IntelliDash has no push-window logic. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q3 and Q4: does a push made after the Lynx synchronisation time, or before 11 AM, fail to reach the course, and does anything in Spatial Adjust or Lynx report it? (The push dialog would still verify the values against Lynx and report success.)

claims.text: The push dialog names the number of stations the threshold adjusted.
claims.note: The banner text is "{{num}} stations will be adjusted according to the minimum threshold rules." or its singular (en-us.json:430, :434). See minimum-threshold/5/3 for what the count includes.

claims.text: Rows below the threshold show an arrow and the adjusted percentage in pink.
claims.note: The arrow icon is grey (#646E73) and the "Adjusted to N%" text is pink (#D93193) (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.less:104-112). The row's original % Adj. stays grey.

claims.text: Reopening Settings shows the value you saved, not the previous one.
claims.note: The dialog is rebuilt on every opening and reads the site settings afresh (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:296, :310-311). An imperial user sees amounts converted from the stored millimetres, but the threshold is a plain percentage.
